questions_and_answers.question: What expression do you use to stop the cab at your destination?
What does 'Koko de tomete kudasai' mean?
What does the particle 'de' indicate after the word 'koko' in this sentence?

answers.answer: The place where something has happened or will happen

questions_and_answers.question: In which previous lesson was the particle 'de' for location of action introduced?
How do you say 'Please stop at the next traffic light'?

answers.answer: Tsugi no shingoo de tomete kudasai.
Tsugi no shingoo ni tomete kudasai.
Tsugi no shingoo made tomete kudasai.
Tsugi no shingoo no tomete kudasai.

questions_and_answers.question: How do you say 'Please stop at the third intersection'?

answers.answer: Mittsu-me no koosaten de tomete kudasai.
Mittsu-me no koosaten ni tomete kudasai.
Mittsu-me no koosaten made tomete kudasai.
San-bansen no koosaten de tomete kudasai.

questions_and_answers.question: Can the location word 'koko' in 'Koko de tomete kudasai' be replaced with other place expressions?

answers.answer: Yes, you can use various other place expressions you have learned to tell the cab driver where to stop

questions_and_answers.question: What does 'kudasai' add to the sentence?
Which sentence is grammatically correct for telling the driver to stop at the next corner?

answers.answer: Tsugi no kado de tomete kudasai.
Tsugi no kado ni tomete kudasai.
Tsugi no kado o tomete kudasai.
Tsugi no kado wa tomete kudasai.

articles.text:
2. How to stop the cab at your destination

When you want to stop the cab at your destination, you can use the following expression:

Koko de tomete kudasai.    Please stop here

Note the particle de (で) after the word koko 'here' in the sentence above. As we mentioned in Lesson 14, an expression of location like koko followed by de indicates the place where something has happened or will happen. Instead of koko in the sentence above you could also use various other place expressions you have learned to tell the cab driver where to stop. For example:

Tsugi no shingoo de tomete kudasai.        Please stop at the next traffic light
Mittsu-me no koosaten de tomete kudasai.   Please stop at the third intersection
